title: Growing Food at Home
text:
Gardening is a popular hobby in many countries. Many people grow vegetables and flowers in small gardens or on balconies. Gardening is good for your health because you walk, dig, and breathe fresh air. It can also help you relax after a busy day.

Anna Lee started a garden in her small flat in London last year. She grows tomatoes, herbs, and strawberries in plastic boxes. Every Sunday, she shares her vegetables with her neighbours. She says the best part is seeing things grow.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what is gardening good for?
According to paragraph two, where does Anna Lee grow her plants?
options: On the roof of a school
In plastic boxes at a shop
In plastic boxes in her small flat

questions.text: What can we infer about Anna Lee from paragraph two?
options: She does not like her neighbours.
She enjoys sharing her vegetables with others.
She has a large farm in the countryside.
She works as a professional farmer.

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Gardening can be healthy and enjoyable.
Plastic boxes are the best way to grow food.

vocabulary.definition: liked or enjoyed by many people
plants used to add flavour to food

paragraph_translations: Bahçecilik birçok ülkede popüler bir hobidir. Birçok insan küçük bahçelerde veya balkonlarda sebze ve çiçek yetiştirir. Bahçecilik sağlığınız için iyidir, çünkü yürürsünüz, kazarsınız ve temiz hava alırsınız. Ayrıca meşgul bir günün ardından rahatlamanıza yardımcı olabilir.

Anna Lee geçen yıl Londra'daki küçük dairesinde bir bahçe kurdu. Plastik kutularda domates, baharat bitkileri ve çilek yetiştiriyor. Her Pazar sebzelerini komşularıyla paylaşıyor. Ona göre en güzel kısım, şeylerin büyümesini görmek.
